plot.frenchies.frenchie.title: Frenchie pen
plot.frenchies.frenchie.setup: Take the spawn egg, bones and water bucket. Spawn one Frenchie inside the pen and tame it with a bone. Use an empty hand to have it stand.
plot.frenchies.frenchie.steps: Use /time set midnight. Watch the dry dog fall asleep. Order it to sit, then stand. Put water at its feet and watch it wake.
plot.frenchies.frenchie.expect: Sitting and water should each prevent sleep. Scoop the water back up. Use /time set noon and check the dry, standing dog stays awake. Time changes affect the whole world.
plot.frenchies.frenchie.carry: Frontpack: Note your adult dog's coat. With an empty hand, crouch and use the dog. Switch to front-facing third person (F5 twice from first person). Look for that coat in the pack and an empty pen. Quit and rejoin.
plot.frenchies.frenchie.release: Check the pack again. Face open space in the pen. Crouch and use empty air with an empty hand, then repeat. One dog should return with the same coat. Stand and use it to check it still obeys your sit command.
